sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: The toolbar's pull-down menus (📦 Data, 🛠 View, 📀 Discography, ⚠️ WARNING, ❌ ERROR) no longer open off-screen. With the toolbar near the bottom of the window, a menu used to open below it anyway, out of sight and out of reach. It now opens upward when there is more room above, and a menu taller than the space available fits the window and scrolls.
